PowerShell is a Windows interactive command shell and scripting language.
Adversaries abuse it to execute commands, run scripts, and load modules.

## Detection

Module logging plus command-line telemetry: `-EncodedCommand`, `-w hidden`,
`-nop`, and `DownloadString` are the high-signal tokens.

## Notes for the reviewer

Ask where the encoded blob comes from and whether the host is a lab fixture.
